quandoUsar: Starting point for a project page header in an app: breadcrumb, title with status, members, actions, and section tabs with counts.
Long screens where the title should get out of the way on scroll without disappearing: the header folds into a compact bar that takes you back to the top.
quandoEvitar: Use `site-header` for a site's top navigation; this block is the header of a page inside the product.
Use `tabs` or `breadcrumb` when you only need the section switch or only the breadcrumb, not the whole set.
If the page scrolls the window, the fold does not happen: it reads the scroll of the block's inner body, which has a fixed height of 640 px.

teclado.acao: In the sections row, move focus to the neighboring tab and select it right away, wrapping around at the ends (Radix tabs).
Select the first or last section.
From the active tab, moves on to the section panel, which is focusable.
On the three-dot button, open the actions menu (Radix).
In the actions menu, move between items and wrap around at the ends.
Closes the menu and returns focus to the three-dot button.

acessibilidade: The breadcrumb sits in a `<nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">` with `aria-current="page"`; when folded it becomes `inert` and a button with the title takes over, scrolling to the top and moving focus to the `<h2>`.
The results of the actions (follow, share, create or complete an issue, copy the link) are announced by a `role="status"` region, and the visual notice is `aria-hidden`.
When an issue is completed, focus moves to the next issue's button or to the panel when the list empties; below 460 px “New issue” becomes icon-only and keeps its `aria-label`.
movimento: Scrolling the body past 16 px folds the header: the intro collapses its height on a spring that does not overshoot, the title shrinks and blurs, and the breadcrumb gives way to the compact title, which only reopens at 4 px from the top.
The active tab's underline slides between tabs, the counts roll, the panel enters sliding 12 px in the direction of the chosen tab, and issue rows open and close their own height.
With “reduce motion” on, the fold, panels, and rows change instantly or only fade, the underline jumps, and the CSS transitions are removed.
responsivo: When the bar gets narrow, “Follow” and “Share update” collapse into the three-dot menu (width on a spring) and only return with some slack, without flickering at the threshold.

The frame's container queries: up to 559 px the first breadcrumb level disappears, the tabs row scrolls sideways with a faded edge, and the rows rearrange; on screens up to 560 px the frame takes almost the full height.
desempenho: A `ResizeObserver` on the bar alone decides when to collapse the actions, and the timers for the simulated actions and the 3.2 s notice are cleared on unmount.
notasIA: `PageHeader` takes no props: project, breadcrumb, people, issues, updates, and files are constants in the file and the actions are simulated, so copy the installed file and replace the data and handlers with your own.
The fold depends on the inner body with its own scroll (`.scroller`) inside a fixed-height frame; with `auto` height the body does not scroll and the header never folds.
Needs `animated-counter`, `avatar`, `avatar-group`, `badge`, `button`, and `progress`, plus the Radix tabs and menu; the example photos come from `@/lib/media`.
